title: Trapped on the wing
text: You're near the touchline and two defenders are closing you down.
tip: When it's crowded, look where the defenders came from. That's where the space is now.

options.text: Pass inside to your free teammate
options.why: Two defenders on you means someone else is free. Find them.
Beating two players in a tight space is really hard. You'll probably lose it.

options.text: Kick it long down the line
options.why: It gets you out of trouble, but you're likely to give the ball away.
